fusions.name: Herdbook Entry
fusions.desc: Hurls a heavy herdbook that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. On a hit, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Shredded Bedding
fusions.desc: Kicks up shredded paper bedding that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Byre Roll
fusions.desc: Calls the roll of your herd: you and every ally regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Lining
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
